concerns: Platform: WordPress + FacetWP (client-side filters). Subclass = 0 constants beyond the five common ones, 0 lines of parsing code.
29 shells = the site's own FacetWP total_rows (29 across 2 pages via /event/page/2/), so the count is proven against the site's stated total. Recon's ~40 was an overestimate.

The site's location field is free text entered by hosts: a county can land in the city slot ('Surrey' for Guildford) and one third-party listing reads 'Bangkok Atrium' as the city. Not fixable generically.
Price range pages ('GBP 200-GBP 350', 'EUR 199 - EUR 1199') are stored as 'Lowest rate' / 'Highest rate' tiers because the site gives no grade labels.
Descriptions are empty on many pages (the page is just a field block): with_description 2/5 is the site, not the parser.

Harness SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT ('4 days') is a false positive from the site's GDPR cookie table ('Duration 1 year 1 month 4 days'); PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK is a free Zoom registration for a webinar. Neither is a missed fee/date. Many BSGE events are third-party (Arlo, Zoom, conference-broker sites) whose own fee pages are shared-explorer territory.
Registration needed in extractors/__init__.py (not touched): import the class and add it to EXTRACTOR_REGISTRY under the new source id. wordpress_generic.py itself needs no registration.

Coverage checklist: (1) multi-day ranges: listing date-range parser plus header-zone range on the detail page, both unit-tested; (2/4/5) fees on external or same-site registration pages are NOT followed by the family - left to remediator.explorer (PLAYBOOK says it handles them); the harness PRICE_*_LINK warnings below are those cases; (3) image fee tables not checked here (no site showed one); (6/7) call-for-papers deadlines left to the merge step per PLAYBOOK (extract_abstract_info is deliberately not called), harness SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE warnings are that step's job; (8) CTA text: no tier labels come from link text; (9) location on page: header-line / labelled-line / JSON-LD parsing, harness LOCATION_ON_PAGE never fired.
No JSON-LD Event exists on any trial site (checked all five listing and detail pages), so the JSON-LD offers path is covered by offline fixtures only, not by a live page.

WP REST path (REST_POST_TYPE) is implemented and unit-tested offline but OFF by default and unproven live: /wp-json/wp/v2/events (ERS) and /wp/v2/event (BCIS) exist but return acf=[] and no event dates (the core 'date' is the publish date); BSGE exposes no events post type. HTML cards are the only date source on these sites.
with_venue in probe_results counts venue_name OR city (both are location evidence); venue_name alone is lower and noted per site.
